<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">STATE OF DELAWARE&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">SECRETARY OF STATE&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">DIVISION OF CORPORATIONS</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">FILED 09:00 AM 04/22/1999&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">991158606900013&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">CERTIFICATE OF AMENDMENT</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">OF</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">CERTIFICATE OF INCORPORATION</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">OF</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">HITECH INVESTMENT INC.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">HITECH INVESTMENT INC., a corporation
organized and existing under and by virtue of the general corporation law of the State of Delaware, DOES HEREBY CERTIFY:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">FIRST, that the Board of Directors of said
corporation, at a meeting duly convened and held, adopted the following resolution.</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">RESOLVED, that the Board of Directors
hereby declares if advisable and in the best interest of the Company that Article FIRST of the Certificate of Incorporation
by amended to read as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">FIRST. The name of this Corporation shall be:</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: center">5 STAR LIVING ONLINE, INC.</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">SECOND. That the said amendment has
been consented to and authorized by the holders of a majority of the issued and outstanding stock entitled to vote by written
consent given in accordance with the provisions of Section 229 of the General Corporation Law of the State of Delaware.</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">THIRD. That the aforesaid amendment was duly
adopted in accordance with the applicable provisions of Sections 242 and 228 of the general Corporation Law of the State of
Delaware.</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, said corporation has
caused this Certificate to be signed by PAUL HAYWARD (PRESIDENT) this 9th day of April, 1999.</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left"></P>
